name: fifa-ticketing-system-distributed
description: FIFA World Cup Ticketing System — Distributed Database Architecture with 4 Regional Shards and Redis Mutex Locking

scripts.build: npm install --prefix fifa-ticket-backend && npm install --prefix fifa-ticket-frontend && npm run build --prefix fifa-ticket-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "cd fifa-ticket-backend && npm run dev" "cd fifa-ticket-frontend && npm run dev"
